author: SGMC
body:
A long time ago...

In a nebula far, far away...

(Haha, get it? I said nebula instead of galaxy. Because this is a nebula map. I'm so funny.)

This is my new nebula map, entitled Star Wars. It's theme is Star Wars. Who would have guessed? The two teams are the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, represented by red and blue. Here's a quick overview of each of the teams:

Galactic Empire:

The Galactic Empire team spawns in a recreation of the Death Star. 

It's monuments are inside of three Tie Fighters, placed on the right, left, and top of the spawn. They are a bit hard to get to, but there are various strategies making it easier.


Rebel Alliance:

This team spawns in the hull of the Millennium Falcon.

The team's monuments are located in 3 X-Wings, similarly to the left, right, and top of the ship. 


Other Features:

Throughout the map, you will come across many other structures, including:
1. The center platform. This platform is placed at the center of the map, and has a total of 64 diamonds placed on it in the form of blocks and ore. It is the main location for most of the map's sword pvp, and is probably where everyone will rush the second the game starts.

2. The halfway platforms. These are smallish platforms placed halfway between the center platform and each team's spawn. They each have one diamond block, and may serve for a sniping base. They are about 15 blocks from the center, so bows could definitely be useful here.

3. The rogue ships. About 5-6 of these small spacecraft are placed in various locations around the map, each containing a single diamond block. They could definitely serve as a forward ops base, or a sniping perch. The diamonds could cause a few interesting 1v1s. 

4. Comets. These medium-sized comets with an outer layer of stained glass and a core of lava and diamond blocks can be a valuable asset to teams, if they can find an easy way of harvesting them. They are probably an end-game feature as they are all quite far from the center.



5. Dwarf planets. About 10 of these miniature planets are floating through the map; each with it's own special purpose. This could range from providing snowballs, to being a food source, to containing diamonds, to much  more. They also add an aesthetic effect to the map, making it feel more spacey.

6. Jump pads. These small, iron contraptions are possibly the most useful part of this map. When stepped on, they give you a jump boost 10 effect, allowing you to jump 20+ blocks into the air. They also give you a resistance effect just long enough to safely land almost any possible jump, but short enough to not make you unkillable for more than one second. They are build-protected by the YAML. Thanks to Mooch24 for the idea!

7. The loadout. Players spawn wearing iron armor for various reasons, including the fact that it would be hard to make a futuristic space map without using excessive iron blocks, and that you can't exactly survive in outer space in a leather quilt.

Map download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/p8gbcl8ge42j98m/Star+Wars+Nebula+Map.zip
YAML: In the map download. I would appreciate if someone could look over it, as it is my second YAML and I have almost no clue how to make one correctly.
